notes.title: Game Update v5.0.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Chickamauga Battles - version 2.1.2 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A unit image for the wrong side may appear after mounting/dismounting some cavalry units.
[/list]

notes.title: Chickamauga Battles version 2.1.1 Update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Chickamauga Battles v2.1.0 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: A reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Play balance in some scenarios.
[*] Change: Initial formations for some units.  Most infantry units in reserve positions now start in column formation rather than line.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. performance.
[*] Change: Updated the combat capabilities of Cavalry with Pistols.
[*] Fix: A critical issue displaying the curved loss meters after the previous graphics update.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[/list]
